tryExecuteSemantics.targetBinding: NpcActionContext.TargetPed = CurrentFocusPed if NpcTargeting.IsValid, else null. Parameter is the raw string (or empty). No turnId/generationId on the context.

onNpcActionExecutedSemantics.succeededTrueMeans: exactly the boolean returned by NpcActionHandler.Invoke, forwarded after the invoke and before TryExecute returns
onNpcActionExecutedSemantics.succeededFalseMeans: handler returned false, OR handler threw (forced ldc.i4.0)
onNpcActionExecutedSemantics.iterates: all registered IIntegration with IsAvailable==true; per-integration exceptions are logged and skipped

stockDispatchSemantics.wbReturnTrue: JSON npcAction was sent to every OPEN websocket client. Does not wait for native TryExecute.

coreHandlerPattern.note: Almost every Core* registrar handler calls an NpcActions void wrapper then returns true with no branches.

npcActionsExecutor.method: NpcActions.m0x60002e4(Ped, string command, policy enum, Action<Ped,NpcState> body)
npcActionsExecutor.vehiclePolicy: closure m0x60003e2; policies 1/2 defer body until forced exit + settle delay; 0/3 run immediately. Newer command can cancel deferred start ('newer command during settle delay' / 'before exit completed').
npcActionsExecutor.generationBump: per-ped integer dictionary f0x4000198 used to detect newer commands during deferred vehicle-exit start

NOT_COMPLETION: Rb dispatched and logged ACTION DISPATCHED
an NpcState *Mode / Wants* flag was set
WEAK: RAGE TaskInvoker / TASK_* native was issued
MEDIUM: Behavior Start ran and matching Update keeps the mode alive
STRONG: ApproachFinished(true) for the same actor+target after the current approach generation (GTA still required for stale-safety)
destination proximity AND destination flags cleared AND no remaining go-to/drive task (arrival predicate still GTA-needed)
